import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from pydantic import ValidationError
from agents.decision import make_final_recommendation as decide
from config.decision_policy import DecisionPolicy
from examples.fixtures import baseline, PASS
from schemas.decision_output import DecisionOutput


class DecisionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.p = baseline()

    def run_decision(self):
        return decide(**self.p)

    def candidate(self, **kwargs):
        value = dict(candidate_id="swap", ingredient="두부", replaces="계란", menu="계란찜", constraints=deepcopy(PASS))
        value.update(kwargs)
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["substitute_candidates"] = [value]
        return value

    def test_case1_keep_and_inventory(self):
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended_servings"], 523)
        self.assertEqual(r["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "ADJUST")
        self.assertTrue(r["requires_human_approval"])
        DecisionOutput.model_validate(r)

    def test_case2_attendance_requests_rerun(self):
        self.p["user_events"] = [{"event_type": "attendance_event", "event_id": "guest-1", "attendance_delta": 35}]
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended_rechecks"], ["demand_forecast", "operation"])
        self.assertIsNone(r["recommended_servings"])
        self.assertEqual(r["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "NEEDS_CONFIRMATION")

    def test_event_acknowledged_by_both(self):
        self.p["user_events"] = [{"event_type": "attendance_event", "event_id": "guest-1", "attendance_delta": 35}]
        for key in ("demand_result", "operation_result"):
            self.p[key]["applied_event_ids"] = ["guest-1"]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["recommended_servings"], 523)

    def test_case3_price_supply_review(self):
        self.candidate()
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"].update(price_risks=[{"ingredient": "계란", "message": "가격 +22%"}],
            supply_risks=[{"ingredient": "계란", "severity": "HIGH"}], affected_menus=["계란찜"])
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertTrue(all(a["decision"] == "REVIEW" for a in r["menu_actions"]))
        self.assertEqual(r["menu_actions"][0]["candidates"], ["swap"])
        self.assertTrue(r["critical_alerts"])

    def test_case4_cheap_failed_nutrition_blocked(self):
        c = self.candidate(soft_scores={"cost": 1.0})
        c["constraints"]["nutrition"] = "FAIL"
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["price_risks"] = [{"ingredient": "계란", "affected_menus": ["계란찜"]}]
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual(r["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")
        self.assertEqual(r["menu_actions"][0]["candidates"], [])

    def test_case5_demo(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["data_quality_notes"] = ["가격 정보: DEMO"]
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual(r["confidence"], "MEDIUM")
        self.assertIn("DEMO", str(r["data_quality_notes"]))

    def test_case6_inventory_nutrition_conflict(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["nutrition_results"] = [{"candidate_id": "tofu-use", "status": "FAIL"}]
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual(r["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")
        self.assertIsNone(r["inventory_actions"][0]["recommended"])

    def test_global_nutrition_failure_blocks_inventory(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["nutrition_constraints"]["status"] = "FAIL"
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_missing_inputs(self):
        r = decide({}, {}, {})
        self.assertEqual(r["confidence"], "LOW")
        self.assertIsNone(r["recommended_servings"])

    def test_unknown_constraints_not_passed(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["constraints"] = {}
        self.assertIsNone(self.run_decision()["recommended_servings"])

    def test_expired_inventory(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["inventory_recommendations"][0]["days_to_expiry"] = -1
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_restriction_normalized(self):
        self.p["user_events"] = [{"event_type": "ingredient_restriction_event", "ingredient": "두 부", "restriction": "do_not_use"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_alias_restriction(self):
        self.candidate(ingredient="계란")
        self.p["user_events"] = [{"event_type": "ingredient_restriction_event", "ingredient": "달걀", "restriction": "do_not_use"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_each_hard_constraint(self):
        for key in PASS:
            with self.subTest(constraint=key):
                c = self.candidate()
                c["constraints"][key] = "FAIL"
                self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_supply_unavailable_overrides_pass(self):
        self.candidate()
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["supply_risks"] = [{"ingredient": "두부", "unavailable": True}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_shortage_probability(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["shortage_probability"] = .2
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["serving_action"]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_insufficient_servings(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["recommended_servings"] = 400
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["status"], "blocked")

    def test_text_alert_does_not_invent_quantity(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"].update(inventory_recommendations=[], alerts=[{
            "type": "expiry_risk", "severity": "HIGH", "message": "두부 8kg D-1"}])
        action = self.run_decision()["inventory_actions"][0]
        self.assertEqual(action["decision"], "NEEDS_CONFIRMATION")
        self.assertIsNone(action["recommended"])

    def test_scoped_allergy_blocks_candidate(self):
        self.candidate()
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["alerts"] = [{"type": "allergy", "severity": "HIGH", "ingredient": "두부", "message": "알레르기"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_nutrition_fail_wins_over_pass(self):
        self.candidate()
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["nutrition_results"] = [
            {"candidate_id": "swap", "status": "FAIL"}, {"candidate_id": "swap", "status": "PASS"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["decision"], "BLOCK")

    def test_bad_numbers_rejected(self):
        for value in (-1, float("nan"), float("inf"), True, "487"):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                decide({"prediction": value}, {}, {})

    def test_missing_event_fields_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            decide({}, {}, {}, [{"event_type": "attendance_event"}])

    def test_duplicate_candidate_id(self):
        self.candidate(candidate_id="tofu-use")
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.run_decision()

    def test_immutable_deterministic(self):
        original = deepcopy(self.p)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision(), self.run_decision())
        self.assertEqual(original, self.p)

    def test_soft_priority_config(self):
        a = self.candidate(soft_scores={"waste": 1.0, "cost": 0.0})
        b = deepcopy(a)
        b.update(candidate_id="cheap", soft_scores={"waste": 0.0, "cost": 1.0})
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["substitute_candidates"].append(b)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["candidate_evaluations"][0]["candidate_id"], "swap")
        policy = DecisionPolicy(priorities=("cost", "shortage", "safety", "nutrition", "supply", "waste", "preference"))
        self.assertEqual(decide(**self.p, policy=policy)["candidate_evaluations"][0]["candidate_id"], "cheap")

    def test_partial_report_suppresses_actions(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["status"] = "partial"
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["inventory_actions"][0]["decision"], "NEEDS_CONFIRMATION")

    def test_order_units_not_inferred(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["order_recommendations"] = [{"ingredient": "돼지고기", "planned_order": 105,
            "recommended_min": 88, "recommended_max": 94, "status": "OVER", "constraints": PASS}]
        a = self.run_decision()["procurement_actions"][0]
        self.assertEqual(a["decision"], "NEEDS_CONFIRMATION")
        self.assertIsNone(a["unit"])

    def test_order_range_preserved(self):
        self.p["operation_result"]["order_recommendations"] = [{"ingredient": "돼지고기", "planned_order": 105,
            "recommended_min": 88, "recommended_max": 94, "status": "OVER", "unit": "kg", "constraints": PASS}]
        self.assertEqual(self.run_decision()["procurement_actions"][0]["recommended"], {"min": 88, "max": 94})

    def test_unknown_recheck_preserved(self):
        self.p["inventory_risk_result"]["recommended_rechecks"] = ["external_unknown"]
        self.assertIn("external_unknown", self.run_decision()["recommended_rechecks"])

    def test_trace_complete(self):
        r = self.run_decision()
        self.assertEqual([t["step"] for t in r["decision_trace"]], list(range(1, len(r["decision_trace"])+1)))
        self.assertTrue(all(t["rule"] for t in r["decision_trace"]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
